first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making simplification the most directly aligned intervention. Verify the onboarding and signup-simplification records because their prior evidence concerns early activation rather than sustainable qualified revenue. Run a small guarded test with downstream quality, retention, and qualified-revenue measures; avoid broad promotional pricing because it may acquire lower-value accounts and erode long-term revenue quality.

final.rationale: Use the slot on a standard A/B test of shortened onboarding for self-serve accounts. The verified record directly addresses both current problems: completion improved 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention rose 3%. Signup simplification also lifted SMB activation 9% and qualified revenue 4%, but its 1% retention decline and unverified applicability outside SMB require segment-specific analysis. Evaluate completion, activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, qualified revenue, and account quality before rollout; do not extend the SMB signup change to other segments without evidence.
